description:
FILED s543b (Opus 5.5, resumed, 2026-11-21) -- a MEASUREMENT trap of tools/everyday-smoke.pl, not a product bug (PCL's output is perl's once the program runs).

THE FINDING.  The FIRST everyday run at a generation whose module cache is cold reads 114 of 122 instead of 115, with ONE NEW
row: `modules/Math-BigInt-BigFloat  TIMEOUT` (the default 60 s per program, `--jobs 2`).  The second run, warm, reads 115 of 122
and NEW 0.  Measured twice today, once per tree, each time with one other bounded leg on the box (load 1.1-3.7):

  * base extraction c5f618f2 (v2-15000), 14:56:22-14:58:30: 114/122, NEW 1 = BigFloat TIMEOUT; 470 module-cache files written
    during the run.  Re-run 15:04:58-15:05:07: 115/122, NEW 0 (the whole battery in 9 s).
  * the s543b tree 1fab14a9 (v2-15200), 15:12:29-15:14:28: 114/122, NEW 1 = BigFloat TIMEOUT; 364 module-cache files written,
    the last of them Math/BigFloat.pm's entry (~/.pcl-cache/modules/044DC3C0ADF1B3FB: source 229,373 bytes, .lisp 663 KB,
    fasl 2.8 MB written at 15:14:27 -- one second before the leg ended).  Re-run 15:15:08-15:15:17: 115/122, NEW 0.

So the cold compile of Math::BigInt + Math::BigFloat at a new generation takes about the whole 60 s budget, and with any other
work on the box it does not fit.  (`./runpcl everyday/modules/Math-BigInt-BigFloat.pl` on the base takes 41 s even warm --
a different path from the smoke's `pcl` runner, which runs the program in well under 9 s warm; not measured further.)

WHERE IT BITES.  `tools/everyday-smoke.pl --record` right after a merge (a new generation = a cold module cache for every
module): the history row would read 114 and the run would exit 1 with a NEW row that is not a regression.  A batch's BEFORE
or AFTER on a fresh generation the same way.

THE CHEAP FIXES (not taken -- outside s543b's brief): the program's header `# timeout: 120` (everyday-battery.md: the
per-program header exists for exactly this), or the smoke warming the module cache first.  Either way, until then: a TIMEOUT
of this one program on a first run at a new generation is re-run before it is read.

Logs: s543b worktree scratch/s543b/everyday-base.log (VOID as a BEFORE), everyday-base2.log, everyday-tree.log (VOID as an
AFTER), everyday-tree2.log.
subject: TOOLING (a measurement trap, not a product bug): the FIRST tools/everyday-smoke.pl run at a new generation reads 114 of 122 -- modules/Math-BigInt-BigFloat TIMEOUTs (60 s) while Math/BigFloat.pm compiles cold; the warm re-run reads 115, NEW 0
triage_reason: a measurement trap: the first everyday run at a new generation reads one low
